tips: Prioritize long-form country documentaries (pk_country) and versus comparisons (pk_versus), which consistently outperform page averages (up to 4.15x).
Always use proper Urdu script in titles and hooks; avoid Roman Urdu titles, which caused an identical Canada vs Australia topic to collapse from 10.5x to 0.19x.
Completely drop niche food content (pk_food) and reduce isolated salary/cost shorts (pk_salary_short), both averaging under 0.43x.
For short formats, stick strictly to high-interest mega-destinations and visual travel facts (e.g., China facts at 11.8x, Singapore tour at 3.96x).
Focus student and immigration scripts on top aspirational hubs (Canada, Australia, Malta, Nordics) rather than low-interest regions like Morocco or Greece.
